model: Distressed asset waterfall (bear) plus capitalised post-restructuring attributable earnings at cost of equity (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment expense line in the FY2025 annual report or H1 2026 interim (grep of 'share-based payment' finds only IFRS 3 acquiree boilerplate); SBC-zero market, house and street bases coincide
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:01Z. Parity check against the A-share: 000002.SZ closed RMB3.66 (= HKD4.29) on 2026-10-16 vs H-share HKD2.43, an H-share discount of ~43% to the A-share. A and H shares rank pari passu in the waterfall; per-share values apply to both lines.
inputs.share_count_basis: 11,930.709m total A+H shares (share capital RMB11,930,709k at RMB1 par, H1 2026 interim balance sheet). No dilutive securities outstanding. Held flat in the engine: the expected restructuring dilution is charged inside each scenario's attributable-earnings stream (earnings x share retained by existing holders) so it is not counted twice.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Discount rate is a cost of equity in CNY, because the capitalised stream is post-interest, post-tax earnings attributable to existing shareholders: China 10y CGB ~1.9% + 6.5% ERP x beta ~1.3 + ~2% post-restructuring / small-float distress premium = ~12.5%. Terminal cap multiple 8x = 1/12.5% so Gordon (g=0) and multiple terminal values agree exactly.
inputs.lease_treatment: Lease liabilities RMB12.75bn (H1 2026) are claims at face in the waterfall; not modelled separately in the capitalised stream (earnings are after lease cost).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI book RMB113.6bn (H1 2026) is project-level partner equity, structurally senior to the parent's equity for the assets it sits on. In the waterfall NCI is charged at book x blended asset recovery ahead of parent shareholders; the capitalised stream is attributable (post-NCI) earnings.
inputs.notes: MODEL CHOICE: routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'Distressed, receivership, delisted, cash shell -> asset or creditor waterfall, not a going-concern model'. Vanke is in S&P selective default (Dec 2025), carries a Deloitte going-concern material-uncertainty paragraph in both the FY2025 audit and the H1 2026 review (RMB178.86bn of borrowings due within one year vs RMB53.08bn cash), lost RMB88.56bn in FY2025 and RMB14.95bn in H1 2026, and attributable equity fell from RMB242.7bn (FY2022) to RMB102.2bn (H1 2026). An owner-FCF DCF is meaningless here: there is no sustainable forward FCF and the outcome for equity is set by how the debt is resolved, not by growth. The valuation is therefore three OUTCOME scenarios, not three growth paths: BEAR = court-led or creditor-led liquidation/restructuring valued by the asset waterfall in asset_waterfall (equity out of the money at every haircut set tested, IV 0); BASE = state-managed extend-and-dilute restructuring, value = capitalised post-restructuring attributable earnings at cost of equity after a 3-year work-out; BULL = full Shenzhen Metro / state backstop with minimal dilution, 2-year work-out. ENGINE ENCODING: each scenario's capitalised stream is entered as a flat revenue base (FY2025 revenue) with growth 0, D&A/capex/tax/WC/SBC 0 and the attributable earnings as the 'ebitda_margin_path' (0 during the work-out years, then earnings / FY2025 revenue); net_debt is 0 in the engine because the stream is already after interest and the debt is resolved inside each scenario (charging net debt again would deduct it twice). The margin path is NOT an operating EBITDA forecast. Actual gross borrowings RMB321.2bn (bank and financial-institution loans 297.25bn + bonds 23.97bn) and cash RMB53.08bn at 2026-06-30 are recorded in total_debt / cash for reference only. No prior DCF exists (fresh build); no MEMORY.md entry. Analysis JSON had a missing closing brace on line 21 (moat_factors[1]); fixed so it parses.

asset_waterfall.source: 2202.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt lines 4929-5020 (condensed consolidated statement of financial position), inventories split lines 5770-5777
asset_waterfall.method: Assets at recovery haircuts, liabilities at face (contract liabilities and current taxation partly relieved: presold units are delivered against contract liabilities, and land appreciation tax provisions reverse as margins fall). Residual first absorbs NCI at book x blended asset recovery, then accrues to the 11,930.7m A+H shares.

assets.note: much is project-escrowed presale cash, but claims are also at face
PHFD 78.8bn, PUD 157.6bn, completed 106.8bn; development segment gross margin -4.2% in FY2025 after RMB20.8bn impairment, H1 2026 further RMB3.94bn; bulk disposals in 2025 cleared at discounts
largely amounts due from JVs/associates and partners, themselves distressed; FY2025 credit impairment ~RMB33.7bn
rental apartments, logistics, malls; gross rent RMB4.93bn in H1 2026

assets.item: Interests in associates and joint ventures
assets.note: mostly equity in co-developed projects; levered, junior to project debt

liabilities.item: Bank loans and borrowings from financial institutions

asset_waterfall.break_even: Blended asset recovery of 77.5% covers liabilities at face; ~89% is needed before parent shareholders receive anything after NCI. Every haircut set tested leaves parent equity at or near zero in a liquidation: the listed equity is an option on avoiding liquidation, which is what the base and bull scenarios value.
asset_waterfall.used_for: bear scenario (IV 0); also the reason base and bull carry a work-out delay and dilution

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (FY2020 RMB224.5bn -> FY2025 RMB116.9bn attributable equity)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS went from RMB1.95 (FY2022) to -7.45 (FY2025) and owner FCF has been negative every year since FY2021 (-5.5bn, -10.1bn, -4.4bn, -0.7bn, -4.2bn), so EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined. Revenue (-22.6% 3yr) and equity (-21.6% 3yr) shrink at similar rates.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF (OCF - capex); SBC is nil and interest income is not deducted because the group has large net debt. None of these growth rates is used in the valuation, which is outcome-based.

base.rationale: State-managed extend-and-dilute. Attributable equity falls from RMB102.2bn (H1 2026) to ~RMB67bn by end-2028 on continued impairments and losses (H2 2026 + 2027 + 2028 ~RMB35bn, against RMB15bn in H1 2026 alone). Shenzhen Metro loan conversion / debt-for-equity swap leaves existing holders 50%. Sustainable ROE 4% thereafter (state-backed peers earn 3-6%). Attributable earnings to existing holders = 67,000 x 4% x 50% = RMB1,340m from year 4 = 0.574% of FY2025 revenue. No flows during the 3-year work-out.

bull.rationale: Full state backstop: public debt extended at par, Shenzhen Metro loans subordinated or converted with only ~15% dilution, sector stabilises in 2027. Equity bottoms at ~RMB80bn, ROE 6% (top of the state-backed peer range). Attributable earnings = 80,000 x 6% x 85% = RMB4,080m from year 3 = 1.748% of FY2025 revenue.

bear.rationale: Liquidation or court-led/creditor-led holistic restructuring (cross-default called on offshore USD bonds, Shenzhen Metro stops lending). Asset waterfall at bear haircuts leaves a RMB274bn shortfall to creditors before NCI; equity receives nothing. Zero stream encodes IV 0.

scenario_narratives.base: State-managed extend-and-dilute (50%). Onshore bonds keep being extended with Shenzhen Metro guarantees, banks roll project loans under the financing-coordination ('whitelist') mechanism, and the shareholder loans (~RMB33.5bn disclosed, more drawn in 2026) are eventually converted or swapped into equity, leaving existing A and H holders with about half the company. Losses continue through 2028 as the legacy 2017-2021 land bank is worked through; the survivor is a smaller developer plus Onewo property services and rental/logistics assets earning a ~4% ROE on ~RMB67bn of equity, capitalised at a 12.5% cost of equity after a 3-year work-out. Roughly RMB0.6 per share, a P/B of ~0.07x on current book, in line with where restructured private developers trade.
scenario_narratives.bull: Full state backstop (20%). Shenzhen SASAC treats Vanke as too systemically important to restructure: public debt is extended at par, shareholder loans are subordinated or converted with only ~15% dilution, and the sector bottoms in 2027. Equity bottoms at ~RMB80bn and earns 6%, comparable to COLI or CR Land, capitalised at 12.5% after a 2-year work-out. Roughly RMB2.1 per share, close to the current H-share price: the market is pricing something near this outcome.
scenario_narratives.bear: Liquidation or holistic restructuring with equity wiped out (30%). Shenzhen Metro has said further open-ended support exceeds its risk tolerance; S&P already rates Vanke SD, and advisers are urging offshore bondholders to call cross-defaults. With RMB178.9bn of borrowings due within a year against RMB53.1bn of cash, a creditor-led process is plausible. The asset waterfall shows recovered assets of ~RMB468bn against ~RMB742bn of claims at bear haircuts, and even at base haircuts (65% inventory, 60% receivables, 70% investment property) creditors are RMB127bn short. Equity value 0.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Outcome probabilities, not house 25/50/25. Bear at 30% because the going-concern doubt, SD rating, widening losses (H1 2026 RMB14.95bn) and Shenzhen Metro's stated limit make a wipe-out restructuring a live outcome. It is not higher because onshore A-share developer restructurings under a state-owned controlling shareholder have historically diluted equity rather than cancelled it, and Shenzhen Metro would be writing off its own ~27% stake. Bull is held to 20% because it needs both open-ended state support, which Shenzhen Metro has publicly capped, and a sector recovery that has not appeared in five years.

valuation_philosophy.summary: For a developer in selective default with a going-concern qualification, equity is a call option on avoiding liquidation. The asset waterfall shows that on any realistic haircut, liquidation leaves shareholders nothing (break-even needs ~89% blended asset recovery). So the value rests entirely on how probable a state-managed survival is and how much dilution it brings. At HKD2.43 (P/B ~0.24 on H1 2026 book), the H-shares are priced close to the bull case, which leaves no margin of safety against the 30% wipe-out branch.
key_risks_to_valuation: Shenzhen Metro / Shenzhen SASAC stance is the single dominant variable: a decision to stop lending moves the base toward the bear, and an explicit guarantee moves it toward the bull
Dilution ratio in any debt-for-equity swap is unknowable today; base assumes existing holders keep 50%, and every 10 points of dilution moves the base IV ~RMB0.13
Inventory and JV/receivable recovery rates: book values already carry large impairments, but 2025 bulk disposals cleared at discounts and FY2025 credit impairments were RMB33.7bn
Further losses before stabilisation could exceed the RMB35bn assumed; H1 2026 alone was RMB14.95bn
Offshore USD bond cross-default acceleration could force a court process regardless of onshore support
H-share holders may be treated differently from A-share holders in a restructuring (the H line trades at a ~43% discount to the A line)
